CrawlEngine with defaults batch scrapes like the free function

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_scrape, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    urls = ["https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2"]
    result = await batch_scrape(engine, urls)
    print(result.completed_count)
    print(result.total_count)

asyncio.run(main())
```
